snippet.title: Tiny Capsule Collector - Official Announcement Trailer | Women-Led Games x SGF 2026
snippet.description: Here's a look at the Announcement Trailer for Tiny Capsule Collector, an idle cozy capsule shop management game developed by Playing Mantis. Players will attract customers, collect capsule toys, and indulge in small moments of joy from the comfort of their desktop computer. Tiny Capsule Collector is coming soon to PC (Steam).
